title: hieracium pseudobifidum subsp. jablanense
intro:
Hieracium pseudobifidum subsp. jablanense, commonly known as the "Serbian hawkweed," is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which may include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, although more research is needed to confirm its efficacy. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium pseudobifidum subsp. jablanense are believed to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, which may include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds. However, the exact bioactive constituents of this plant are not well-documented and require further investigation.
